title: Basis of a property value (structural enumeration, mirrored in the JSON Schema)

terms.label: Specification
terms.definition: A release limit the publisher guarantees for every batch.

terms.label: Typical
terms.definition: A typical value; not guaranteed, not part of the specification.

terms.label: Measured
terms.definition: The result of a specific test or study.

terms.label: Recommended
terms.definition: The publisher's recommendation for use (for example a use level).

terms.label: Regulatory limit
terms.definition: A limit set by a regulator or a standard-setting body; requires scope.region and its own as_of.

terms.label: Calculated
terms.definition: Derived by calculation or simulation, not measured.

terms.label: Declared
terms.definition: A declaration by the publisher without a test behind it (for example a function).
